'''Brook Lopez''' (born [[April 1]], [[1988]] in [[North Hollywood, California|North Hollywood]], [[California]]) is a 7'0" [[United States|American]] [[college basketball|basketball]] player who played for [[Stanford]] in the [[Pacific Ten|Pacific-Ten Conference]] of the [[National Collegiate Athletic Association|NCAA]] and is waiting for the NBA draft for his new team.  He is the identical twin brother of current teammate [[Robin Lopez]]. 

==Biography==
Brook Lopez was born into beginnings in Panorama City, CA on April 1st, 1988 to Deborah Ledford and his now estranged father Heriberto Lopez, a native of Cuba. He was born into a life of basketball and art, as his grandfather played at the [[University of Colorado at Boulder|University of Colorado]] and his aunt was an architect residing in the Bay Area. Lopez moved from [[Hollywood, California]] to [[Oak Harbor, Washington]] while in second grade to be near his older brother, Alex, who was playing basketball at the [[University of Washington]] at the time. He moved to his current hometown of [[Fresno, California|Fresno, CA]] a year later, where he attended San Joaquin Memorial High School. Here, he played with his twin brother [[Robin Lopez]], as well as current [[University of Washington|Washington]] standout Quincy Pondexter. Both teammates played with Lopez on their successful AAU team, the Elite Basketball Organization (EBO), along with Derrick Jasper of the [[University of Kentucky|University of Kentucky]] and Trevo'nn Willis of [[University of Nevada, Las Vegas|UNLV]].

During the 2006-2007 basketball season, Lopez was honored as an All-Pac-10 Honorable Mention while being named to the All-Pac-10 Freshman Team. He averaged 12.6 points and 6.0 rebounds over the course of the season.

Brook Lopez was academically ineligible for the fall quarter in 2007 for a substandard performance in the classroom.<ref>[http://gostanford.cstv.com/sports/m-baskbl/mtt/lopez_brook00.html Men's Basketball - Stanford University Official Athletic Site<!-- Bot generated title -->]</ref>

On [[March 31]], [[2008]], it was reported that both Lopez brothers would enter the [[NBA Draft]].
